Join as many curves as possible being closer than a distance

**Panel:** Comma → Curve · **Nickname:** `Join+`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curves | `C` | Curve | List |  | Curves to join |
| Tolerance | `T` | Number | Item | `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc?.ModelAbsoluteTolerance ?? 1e-2` | Distance tolerance to join |
| Option | `O` | Integer | Item | `1` | Joining option<br>Options: Blend; Extend |
| Make close | `M` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Option to close the curve by extending the last segment |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | List | Joined Curve |
